say:1:1060101001:1.text: There's been gruglins around Holistone. Be careful outside of town.
say:1:1060101001:1.source_cn: 最近咕布林频繁出没，进出圣石镇务必多加小心。

choice_prompt:2:1060101001.text: There's been gruglins around Holistone. Be careful outside of town.
choice_prompt:2:1060101001.source_cn: 最近咕布林频繁出没，进出圣石镇务必多加小心。

say:3:1060101002:1.text: Yes, so stay vigilant out there.
say:3:1060101002:1.male: Yes, so stay vigilant out there.
say:3:1060101002:1.female: Yes, so stay vigilant out there.

say:4:1060101004:1.text: Sadly, we don't have enough soldiers in Holistone to send everyone after the gruglins. We still need soldiers in the town for security reasons.
say:4:1060101004:1.source_cn: 说来惭愧，圣石镇可以调用的士兵不多，还要留下一批守卫镇...

say:5:1060101005:1.text: So, even with all the soldiers we've dispatched, we're not going to get rid of all of them in one go.
say:5:1060101005:1.source_cn: 所以，即便是派出了那么多士兵，恐怕也不能一口气把他们全...

say:6:1060101006:1.text: Dura above, I wish we had more help here in Holistone...
say:6:1060101006:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，要是有人能帮帮圣石镇就好了……

choice_prompt:7:1060101006.text: Dura above, I wish we had more help here in Holistone...
choice_prompt:7:1060101006.source_cn: 艾雅在上，要是有人能帮帮圣石镇就好了……

say:8:1060101007:1.text: What? Really?! Has the goddess answered my prayers...?
say:8:1060101007:1.source_cn: 哎？！真的吗？\n难道女神真的听到了我的愿望……？
say:8:1060101007:1.male: What? Really?! Has the goddess answered my prayers...?
say:8:1060101007:1.female: What? Really?! Has the goddess answered my prayers...?

say:9:1060101008:1.text: Whatever the reason, thanks for the helping hand.
say:9:1060101008:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，谢谢您愿意伸出援手。
say:9:1060101008:1.male: Whatever the reason, thanks for the helping hand.
say:9:1060101008:1.female: Whatever the reason, thanks for the helping hand.

say:10:1060101009:1.text: Gruglins usually lurk around right on the edge of town. Keep going down this road, and you'll see.
say:10:1060101009:1.source_cn: 咕布林平时就出没于镇子周围，沿着这条路一直往前走就能看到了。

say:11:1060101010:1.text: If you could clear them, on behalf of all of us in Holistone, I'll make it well worth your while!
say:11:1060101010:1.source_cn: 如果您能清除他们，我一定会代表圣石镇，为您送上丰厚的报酬！
say:11:1060101010:1.male: If you could clear them, on behalf of all of us in Holistone, I'll make it well worth your while!
say:11:1060101010:1.female: If you could clear them, on behalf of all of us in Holistone, I'll make it well worth your while!

choice:7:0:1.text: What a coincidence! I can help.
choice:7:0:1.male: What a coincidence! I can help.
choice:7:0:1.female: What a coincidence! I can help.

choice:2:0:1.text: Have there been a lot of gruglins?
choice:2:0:1.male: Have there been a lot of gruglins?
choice:2:0:1.female: Have there been a lot of gruglins?

say:13:1060101003:1.text: Some soldiers have been sent to deal with this.
say:13:1060101003:1.male: Some soldiers have been sent to deal with this.
say:13:1060101003:1.female: Some soldiers have been sent to deal with this.

choice:2:1:2.text: Is someone taking care of this?
choice:2:1:2.male: Is someone taking care of this?
choice:2:1:2.female: Is someone taking care of this?
